title: fix(mcp): allow null content in assistant tool-call messages
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16635

- Accepts null or omitted assistant message content in tool-call continuations and passes tool calls and tool results through unchanged.
- Adds one regression test, "generateText accepts assistant tool calls with null content for tool-use continuation", in `packages/mcp/test/textService.test.js`.
- Verified: the regression fails on `main` and passes with the fix; `npm test --silent` show no new problems.

_Found and fixed by Ribbert; manually refreshed and verified with Codex._

<!-- ribbert:bug=13:53c21511 -->

gist.headline: Tools can take the floor
gist.blurb: An assistant can call a tool without filling in the message first. MCP lets the call and its result carry the conversation along.
gist.summary: MCP text generation accepts null or omitted content in assistant tool-call messages and preserves tool calls and tool results unchanged during continuation.
gist.impact: Tool-using conversations can continue when an assistant message contains a tool call but no text content.
gist.visual_concept: Depict an MCP tool-use conversation as a cozy relay: Polli passes a blank message card bearing a small tool icon to the monitor robot, which returns a result card. The empty card is intentional; a code-plant and glowing terminal tie the scene to developer tools.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, wearing a tiny tool belt as she hands a blank tool-call card to a friendly CRT monitor robot beside a code-plant. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a prominent lime green (#ecf874) terminal glow, warm cream background, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
